The [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] '''Trickster Decoy''' was a small one-use self-propelled [[warhead countermeasure]]. It was capable of broadcasting electromagnetic signatures as well as an [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] image of a full-sized [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. It was often used as a decoy by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Though effective at long range, it was vulnerable to focused scans.
